objectives.main: To develop and evaluate, through a historical simulation with a two-hour pre-departure cutoff, a classification framework using Logistic Regression, KNN, SVM and Random Forest, and assess whether its predictions can reliably identify and prioritize flights at risk of departing at least 15 minutes late.

supporting.title: Select and verify a suitable classifier
supporting.statement: To select the most suitable classifier through chronological validation and verify its delayed-flight detection performance and computational practicality on the final evaluation period.
supporting.evidence: Chronological mean delayed-class F1 for selection, AP as tie-break; precision, recall, F1, AP and runtime for confirmation.
supporting.visuals: Model comparison bars, precision-recall curves and confusion matrix.
supporting.not_eda: Requires fitted model scores, frozen predictions and observed outcomes on later-period flights.

supporting.title: Measure the value of additional information
supporting.statement: To assess whether adding origin weather, historical departure-delay patterns and scheduled airport traffic improves departure-delay classification compared with schedule features alone, using the same later-period flights and stated input-availability assumptions.
supporting.evidence: Paired changes in average precision and F1 from A (schedule) to B (schedule plus weather/history/traffic), using identical flights.
supporting.visuals: Matched A/B model comparison in notebooks and report.
supporting.not_eda: Requires controlled model retraining and evaluation; raw correlations do not establish predictive improvement.

supporting.title: Identify prediction strengths and failure patterns
supporting.statement: To evaluate the reliability of the selected model across airports, airlines and departure time bands by identifying missed delays and false alerts in sufficiently supported subgroups.
supporting.evidence: Subgroup recall, false-negative rate, false-positive rate and precision, with denominator counts and support flags.
supporting.visuals: Supported subgroup results in the report and saved evaluation exports.
supporting.not_eda: Compares model predictions with actual outcomes; high observed delay frequency alone does not identify model failure.

supporting.title: Assess the usefulness of risk prioritization
supporting.statement: To quantify how effectively the selected model concentrates actual delayed flights within predeclared review budgets of 5%, 10% and 20% of scored flights, compared with random prioritization and a simple historical-risk baseline.
supporting.evidence: Delayed-flight recall, precision, lift and false alerts within the highest-ranked review quota.
supporting.visuals: Fixed-quota ranking results in the report and saved evaluation exports.
supporting.not_eda: Requires model scores and a retrospective ranking evaluation; it cannot be answered by counting historical delays.

split.membership: Exact selected flight IDs; the 2025 population is larger than the final training sample.
split.validation: Chronological development/calibration/scoring folds inside 2025; no separate final validation partition.
split.disclosure: July was the final confirmation period and is now exposed; do not retune using its outcomes.

C.name: with_aircraft_rotation
C.availability_gate: Not part of current objectives, training or reported findings. Reopening requires a separate scope decision and historical assignment-timing evidence.

evaluation.rotation_selection_note: Aircraft rotation is excluded. Select and evaluate candidates from A/B only.
evaluation.availability_disclosure: Weather receipt times and timely outcome-feed access are assumed, not verified by these sources. Historical schedule revisions are not reconstructed.
evaluation.final_refit: Fit on the exact 40,000 all-2025 IDs in cohorts.json; preserve settings and October thresholds. Final split=test contains the 10,000 July 2026 flights.

history.availability_note: Retrospective outcome-feed assumption; monthly BTS releases do not establish live delivery.

preprocessing.indicator_policy: Median impute every numeric predictor; skip redundant automatic indicators for columns represented by explicit missingness flags. Preserve automatic indicators for remaining numeric predictors, including wind and gust.
preprocessing.month_encoding: Fixed 12-month sine/cosine; raw month retained for audit, sampling and grouped summaries.
